text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with a 14-person field sales team for one quarter. Here's what actually happened.

**What worked**
Reps got back about 5 hours a week. CRM updates went from "Friday night chore" to done before the next meeting. Follow-up emails went out same day, not three days later.

**What surprised us**
Managers gained the most. Coaching shifted from "how'd it go?" to reviewing real conversations.

**What didn't work**
Some customers hesitated when asked for consent. Reps who explained the "why" upfront got a yes almost every time. Those who mumbled it didn't.

**Our takeaway**
The tool didn't make anyone a better seller. It removed the admin so they could be one.

Piloting something similar? What are you measuring?
